Based on my research, the performer from **Night Rocker** is **David Hasselhoff**. His debut album was titled "Night Rocker," released in 1985, featuring singles like "Do You Love Me."

On the CBS daytime drama **The Young and the Restless**, David Hasselhoff played the character **Dr. William "Snapper" Foster Jr.** (often simply called Dr. Snapper Foster). He portrayed this character from 1975 to 1982, which was his first major television role. Interestingly, Hasselhoff would later reprise the role in 2010, over three decades after his original departure from the show.
